items.title: The pullback along a flat finitely presented morphism with geometrically reduced fibres commutes with products
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the etale pullback along a flat, locally finitely presented morphism with geometrically reduced fibres commutes with products (statement lines 16746-16752). The proof (proof lines 16754-16782) is a five-term computation of sections on a good object, using sections upstairs twice and locality of the pullback, followed by the covering lemma that reduces arbitrary objects to such good ones. H2: one section computation plus locality, written out.
